# Leif Taylor — AI-Native Principal Engineer & Product-to-Production Architect

Leif Taylor translates ambiguous business requirements into secure, scalable, revenue-producing systems — using agentic workflows to move from idea to production at exceptional speed.

More than a decade in production engineering, principal architecture, DevOps leadership, and AI-native delivery. Operates across product translation, full-stack implementation, infrastructure, testing, and observability.

## How he works
End-to-end. One operator across product translation, architecture, full-stack code, tests, infrastructure, and production — agentic workflows for speed, deep architectural judgment for trust. Where a 2019 team spent a quarter coordinating handoffs across specialists, he ships a working system in weeks.

## Current role
Principal Engineer at ConnectBase (Westborough, MA) — promoted from Director of DevOps in 2023. Owns architecture, AI-native delivery, and revenue-critical product systems across pricing, supplier integration, and ordering platforms.

## Notable outcomes
- $600K Azure spend reduction landed in 2 months at ConnectBase — same product, same headcount
- 30+ legacy services comprehended, re-architected, and replaced with modern stateless systems
- 10K+ supplier products ingested weekly through an AI pipeline with evals, no human in the loop on the happy path
- Direct-to-Supplier Ordering shipped 0→1 — wholesalers and channel partners now purchase from thousands of suppliers in one interface

## AI-native operating mode
- Daily use of agentic dev workflows (Claude Code, sub-agent orchestration, MCP-style tool integration)
- AI-assisted test authorship across 30+ services
- Production RAG, semantic search, eval harnesses, prompt-version control
- Owns the team's operating patterns for AI-augmented delivery — when to delegate, where the human-in-the-loop boundary sits, how to validate generated work
